author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.2 shipped: v5.103.2: Preset writes that stick (resume-then-pin)
why: Two framing-disjoint plan reviews CHANGED what got built: the plan's proposed chokepoint did not exist (11 setpoint-writing functions, 0 referencing borrow, return_excursion emits no writes), and the plan conflated 'make writes land' with 'make excursions restore' — which are disjoint, since D2a only helps sites that call the chokepoint and the non-restoring sites never reach it. An adversarial build review then found an I3 violation IN THE FIX: resume succeeds, pin raises, exception escapes a bare await, zone left cleared with no hold on the vendor schedule indefinitely — the repair would have caused the exact harm it exists to prevent. Closed with a wrapped pin, an obligatory retry after a clear, and an ERROR rather than silence. Three hollow anchors were self-caught by the mutation drill, all string-based source assertions, one of which let the I3 retry be deleted with the suite green.
implications: Shipped HVAC-MANUAL-PRESET-CONTRACT-1 at v5.103.2; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.2.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: zone_1 manual occupancy over 24h falls from the 69.6%/7d baseline toward zone_3's ~6% AND the multi-hour tail (max 1073min) disappears; discriminating negative = zone_3 does NOT regress into new short manual/unnamed episodes; zero 'resume-then-pin: CLEARED ... could not pin' ERROR lines

refs.release_notes:
Step 1 of HVAC-SUPPLE-SEQUENCE-1. Tier 3. Changes HOW URA writes presets, not WHICH preset any decider chooses.

MECHANISM (measured live): a Bryant/Carrier zone in an ANONYMOUS hold (hold_activity=="manual", which any raw setpoint write leaves behind) will not accept a named activity hold written over it — the cloud keeps the setpoints and discards the NAME. Direct pins reverted in 44s and 68s; resume-then-pin held 8 minutes across 9 cloud-confirmed refreshes. While a zone reads manual, should_change_preset returns False for everything, so vacancy grace and entry dwell sit downstream of a closed gate: zone_1 measured 69.6% manual over 7 days with a 17.9-hour worst-case stranding.

D1 per-kind suppression TTL: preset-kind 120s (spans resume->pin->refresh->verify, above the measured 42-79s refresh window); temp-kind STAYS 5s because it is the only path that swallows a genuine human manual flip.

D2a resume-then-pin inside emit_set_preset_mode, the chokepoint that already existed. Conditional on an anonymous hold so named holds still pin directly, plus a capability gate on the entity's own preset_modes so non-Carrier thermostats fall through to today's behaviour.

D2b the two excursion RETURN paths (solar-banking release, pre-heat return) now restore the preset from the snapshot their token already carried. hvac_predict.py previously contained zero preset emissions.
